title: Regulatory Document
description: Schema for a regulatory document such as a proposed rule, final rule, notice, or guidance document as returned by the Federal Register API or Regulations.gov API.

documentId.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory document.

title.description: Official title of the regulatory document.

agencyName.description: Full name of the issuing agency.

publicationDate.description: Date the document was published in the Federal Register.

effectiveDate.description: Date the rule becomes effective (for Final Rules).

commentDeadline.description: Deadline for public comments (for Proposed Rules).

openForComment.description: Whether the document is currently open for public comment.

cfrCitations.description: Code of Federal Regulations citations affected by this document.

abstractText.description: Brief abstract or summary of the regulatory document.

fullTextUrl.description: URL to the full text of the document.

pdfUrl.description: URL to the PDF version of the document.

topics.description: Subject matter topics covered by this document.

rin.description: Regulation Identifier Number from the Unified Agenda.
